core: Cytokine control of NK and NKT cells
qualifier: IL-15, IL-21 and type I/III interferon
name: IL-15/IL-21 and interferon signaling in NK and NKT cells
rationale: Members are IL-15, IL-21 and type I/III interferon responses plus NK and NKT cell proliferation, differentiation and activation; confusables instead carry IL-10/IL-12/IL-23/IL-27 family signaling and wound-related IL-20/IFN-lambda production.

qualifier: RAS activation and GAP control, oncogenic RAS/RAF mutants
name: RAS regulation and RAF-MAPK activation, including oncogenic mutants
rationale: All members concern RAS GTPase activation/inactivation (SOS, GAPs, NF1) and RAF-MEK-ERK signaling including BRAF/RAF1/RAS mutants; confusables focus on ERK inactivation, MAPK mutants and dephosphorylation-based suppression.

qualifier: with mitochondrial RNA processing, decay and import
name: tRNA maturation and mitochondrial RNA processing and turnover
rationale: Members cover tRNA end processing, splicing, transport and tRF biogenesis in nucleus and mitochondria plus mitochondrial RNA 3'-end processing, catabolism and import; confusables instead hold mitochondrial transcription/translation or tRNA aminoacylation and modification chemistry.

qualifier: and its inherited defects
name: Mucin-type O-GalNAc glycosylation and its genetic defects
rationale: All members concern O-GalNAc glycan initiation/termination and GALNT/C1GALT1C1 deficiency disorders, distinguishing it from N-glycan, sialylation, fucose and blood-group antigen confusables.

qualifier: PI3K cascade and FGFR4/betaKlotho adaptor arms
name: FGFR PI3K cascade and FGFR4-betaKlotho adaptor signaling
rationale: Members are the PI3K cascade from FGFR1-4 plus FRS/SHC signaling of FGFR4 and betaKlotho ligand binding, whereas confusables carry phospholipase C cascades and FGFR1/FGFR2 adaptor signaling.

core: Protein targeting to the plasma membrane
qualifier: GLUT4 translocation via RHOQ
name: RHOQ-driven GLUT4 targeting to plasma membrane
rationale: All three members concern regulated delivery of membrane protein (GLUT4) to the plasma membrane with the RHOQ/TC10 GTPase, unlike confusables about glucose import regulation, insulin/incretin secretion or endosomal transport.

qualifier: via suppressed integrin and Rho/Rac signaling
name: Suppression of integrin-Rho/Rac-driven cell-matrix adhesion and protrusion
rationale: Every member negatively regulates integrin, Rho/Rac signaling, lamellipodia or cell-substrate adhesion (or promotes focal adhesion disassembly), unlike confusables about CDC42 protrusion, angiogenesis or epithelial migration.

core: tRNA and rRNA modification and maturation
qualifier: for translational fidelity, including cytosolic rRNA modification
name: tRNA and rRNA modification and maturation for translational fidelity
rationale: Members span tRNA processing, modification and aminoacylation, rRNA methylation/pseudouridylation, RNA editing and translational fidelity; confusables are dominated by mitochondrial gene expression or protein-level translation factor modification.

qualifier: ephrin, SLIT-ROBO, netrin-DCC and L1 cues
name: Axon guidance by ephrin, SLIT-ROBO, netrin-DCC and L1 signaling
rationale: All members concern axon guidance and fasciculation through ephrin, ROBO, DCC/netrin and L1 receptors with RAC/CDC42 control; confusables lack ephrin and L1 and emphasize semaphorin/netrin repulsion or neuron-type-specific guidance.

qualifier: proteasomal turnover regulation and TRiC/CCT folding
name: Protein stability control via proteasomal turnover and TRiC/CCT folding
rationale: Members regulate protein stabilization/destabilization, K48/auto-ubiquitination and proteasomal degradation alongside TRiC/CCT-assisted folding, whereas confusables cover actin/tubulin folding, deubiquitinases, ERAD and autophagy.

qualifier: positive and negative chemotaxis control
name: Monocyte activation, aggregation, extravasation and chemotaxis regulation
rationale: All members concern monocyte (and macrophage) activation, aggregation, extravasation and up/down regulation of chemotaxis, unlike confusables about inflammatory cytokine production or CCR2/CX3CR1 expression modules.

core: Negative regulation of innate inflammatory signaling
qualifier: TLR/IL-1/TNF to NF-kappaB
name: Negative regulation of TLR/IL-1/TNF-NF-kappaB signaling and inflammatory cytokines
rationale: Members dampen TLR, IL-1 and TNF signaling, canonical and non-canonical NF-kappaB, and proinflammatory cytokine production; confusables involve IL-10 regulation, inflammasomes or positive TLR/cytokine regulation.

qualifier: MPS I, II, VI and IX
name: Dermatan/chondroitin sulfate degradation and MPS I, II, VI, IX
rationale: Members are CS/DS proteoglycan catabolism and the mucopolysaccharidoses affecting it (Hurler, Hunter, Maroteaux-Lamy, Natowicz), distinct from confusables centred on heparan/keratan sulfate (Sanfilippo, Morquio) or Sly syndrome.

qualifier: peptide-hormone and nutrient GPCR signaling, GI motility
name: Feeding regulation, gut motility and nutrient/peptide-hormone GPCR signaling
rationale: Members cover appetite and food intake, GI smooth muscle and gastric secretion, and GPCRs for calcitonin/amylin, glucagon, relaxin, somatostatin and fatty acids; confusables emphasize GH, prolactin, leptin and glucocorticoid axes.

core: RNA polymerase II transcription cycle control
qualifier: promoter clearance through pausing, elongation and termination
name: RNA polymerase II promoter clearance, pausing, elongation and termination
rationale: Members regulate Pol II preinitiation, promoter clearance, pausing, elongation and termination; confusables are initiation/HIV-transcription centred or generic mRNA transcription modules.

qualifier: sorting, maturation and recycling
name: Endosomal sorting, maturation and recycling of internalized cargo
rationale: All members concern endocytosis, early-to-late/recycling endosome transport, receptor recycling and endosome organization, unlike confusables about Golgi, secretory and ARF/Rab signaling.

qualifier: leukocyte adhesion and vascular wound healing
name: Endothelial activation, leukocyte adhesion and vascular remodeling/wound healing
rationale: Members concern endothelial activation, apoptosis and sprouting, leukocyte adhesion/extravasation and vascular remodeling and repair; confusables centre on smooth muscle cells, monocytes or VEGF/FGF growth factor control.

qualifier: including histone stem-loop processing
name: Polyadenylation, histone mRNA 3'-end processing and mRNA nuclear export
rationale: Members cover cleavage/polyadenylation, SLBP-dependent histone mRNA processing, Pol II termination and mature mRNA export; confusables lack 3'-end processing and instead hold mRNA decay or ribosome/tRNA nuclear export.

qualifier: positive regulation
name: Promotion of B cell proliferation and differentiation
rationale: Members are positive regulation of B cell proliferation and differentiation (including B-1 cells) and B cell expression modules, unlike confusables about germinal center/Tfh, BCR signaling or B cell homeostasis and apoptosis.

qualifier: COPI-mediated, intra-Golgi and Golgi-to-ER
name: COPI-mediated retrograde and intra-Golgi vesicle traffic
rationale: Members are COPI budding, Golgi-to-ER and intra-Golgi retrograde transport and Golgi retention, distinct from confusables on Golgi organization/disassembly and COPII ER export.

core: Cyclic nucleotide control of fluid and blood pressure
qualifier: natriuretic peptide-cGMP axis
name: Natriuretic peptide-cGMP control of sodium excretion and blood pressure
rationale: Members cover cGMP synthesis and receptor guanylyl cyclase signaling, natriuresis, diuresis, heart rate and neural blood pressure control, whereas confusables are dominated by renin-angiotensin, endothelin and vasoconstriction.

qualifier: XBP1/ATF4 arms and pancreatic beta-cell apoptosis
name: XBP1/ATF4 ER stress response and beta-cell apoptosis regulation
rationale: Members are ATF4 and XBP1 ER stress transcription, ER overload and control of ER stress-induced and beta-cell apoptosis; confusables hold the ATF6/CREB3 arm or eIF2alpha kinase/mitochondrial stress responses.

qualifier: sperm DNA packaging and piRNA transposon silencing
name: Germline chromatin: sperm DNA packaging and piRNA-directed transposon silencing
rationale: Members concern sperm chromatin condensation and protamine exchange, spermatogonial division and piRNA/DNA-methylation heterochromatin silencing of transposons, while confusables cover piRNA biogenesis or germline specification and stem cell maintenance.

qualifier: RNA polymerase I and nucleolar chromatin regulation
name: RNA polymerase I rRNA transcription and nucleolar chromatin control
rationale: Members are Pol I initiation, elongation and termination and their regulation by NoRC, SIRT1, B-WICH and nucleolar chromatin (plus 5S rRNA by Pol III); confusables are Pol III/snRNA transcription, rRNA cleavage or MYC targets.

qualifier: elongation complex assembly with and without Tat
name: HIV-1 elongation complex assembly, Tat-dependent and Tat-independent
rationale: All three members concern forming and recovering HIV-1 Pol II elongation complexes with or without Tat, unlike confusables on elongation arrest, host Pol II elongation or HIV initiation and capping.
